title: Maybe Something Good Will Occur From This
body:
# Maybe Something Good Will Occur From This

MSGWOFT is a Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 that brings together a diverse collection of additions — from new wildlife and combat tools to quality-of-life improvements — each designed to feel like a natural extension of the base game.

-----------------------------------------
## 🐦 Ravens

New wildlife that soar through your world, bringing life and atmosphere to the skies above. While adding a way to transport items to other players via bundles

-----------------------------------------
## ⚗️ Chemistry

A new layer of crafting and progression that lets you experiment with materials and reactions beyond what vanilla has to offer.

-----------------------------------------
## 🔬 Data Specimens
Collectible via the Rock Scanner Tool - Identify them to use them within the Chemistry Table as the base item

-----------------------------------------
## 💥 Flashbangs
A Funny Addition that temporaly blind other players. But if they are close enougth its perment till death

-----------------------------------------
## 📖 Written Recipes
Unique Recipes for the Chemistry Table — only found. Written Recipes spawn inside chests of every type across the world, hiding crafting knowledge that can't be obtained any other way. Seek them out if you want access to the Chemistry Recipes. (Ignores JEI & ect)

-----------------------------------------
## ⚒️ Copper Armor & Tools
A full backport of Copper Armor and Tools to 1.21.1, finally giving Copper the place in your progression it always deserved.

-----------------------------------------
## 🗂️ Tab Sections
Creative inventory tabs are now neatly divided into logical sections, making it faster and easier to find exactly what you're looking for without the clutter.

------------------------------------------
## ⚠️ Disclaimer
This mod will not be updated past 1.21.1 due to [Veil](https://modrinth.com/mod/veil) not going past 1.21.1

Features within this mod will be included into future mods so this mod will continued to be updated for this version but once I'm done the final touches. This mod will be discontinued

## Credits

Arathain - The ravens (Models, Sounds & Particals)

------------------------------------------
## Final Plans
- Adjust recipes & Removal of blocks & effects (v1.3)
- Adjustment for items that are no longer useful (v1.4)
- Add more jerky varients (v1.5)
- More Deadly Explosives & Bundle Recipe (v1.6)
- Add Particles for each raven varient(v1.7)
